meta_title: pepo — a new way to chat
meta_description: A clean, consistent chat client for Twitch — with 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes, followed channels, and a composer that stays out of the way. Cross-platform desktop, open source.
hero_subtitle: A clean, standalone chat client for Twitch. With support for 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes.
feature_group_chat_blurb: Reading, sending, and rendering Twitch chat.
feature_chat_events: Channel event feed: subs, timeouts, bans
feature_chat_decorations: Chat decorations: first-time chatter, resubs, watch streaks, giant emotes
feature_group_emotes_blurb: Emotes, composer flow, and account-level chat identity.
feature_group_channels_blurb: Finding channels and keeping track of what's live.
feature_channels_live_sorting: Live status, viewer counts, live sorting
feature_group_app_blurb: Desktop behavior, preferences, and future platforms.
install_intro: Download the latest release for your platform. Pepo will notify you when updates are available and update itself in-place.
